summary: Iteration 43 — Community/Members directory feature tested end-to-end. Backend (13/13 pytest cases) and frontend self-card flow + admin view both fully green. Admin balance preserved at 75.485 EUR. No critical issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: community.py — _compute_account_status_label only inspects the LAST withdrawal. If the user has a tax_pending withdrawal that was later superseded by a completed one, the label is computed only from the most recent record, which is fine. But has_pending_tax in /community/members iterates *all* withdrawals, so a long-completed tax_pending could still flag it as has_pending_tax=true forever — consider scoping to non-final statuses or only the latest record per same withdrawal id.
USD→EUR conversion uses a hard-coded 1.08 divisor in two places (members + recent-withdrawals). Centralise via a shared helper / FX service to avoid drift.

deposits aggregation does not de-duplicate by transaction id (it sums every doc returned). Currently fine because the query is filtered by status='completed', but a brief comment warning about the absence of GroupBy would help.
Sort uses 'verified' membership in badges as proxy for verified — works but a dedicated key on the user doc would be cleaner.
Frontend: counts.all uses members.length but the response is capped at limit=200; if user-base grows past 200 the chip count will silently undercount. Either expose a server-side total or paginate.
